Siren`s Kiss.description: 1d4+1 Charm and Appearance, and induces deep magical sleep. Sleeping beings will not wake except by magic Waken, Dispel Magic, Wish, etc.

Skymoss.name: Skymoss
Skymoss.description: Grants the magical ability to fly in any direction at 3` per Intelligence point per second. The being does not need to maintain concentration while flying, but still must make Intelligence saves to successful change direction or make any difficult moves. Furthermore, the being can harness the moss`s innate static charge to envelop themselves in an Aura of electricity, gaining 3 points of Force Armor, immunity to electricity, and causing anything entering the user`s Aura to take 5d8 points of electrical damage. Each dose of Skymoss can create only one Aura of electricity, after which the moss`s static charge is spent.

Sludge Stalk.name: Sludge Stalk
Sludge Stalk.description: Grants +1d4 Will for the duration. Causes any plants, magical plants, and slimes who come within 10` of the user to obey their mental commands. Greater slimes and sapient/magical plants get a Control Resistance (6-10th level), but arch slimes (10th+ level) cannot be controlled. While under the herb`s effect, there is a 50% chance per minute of transforming into a slime equal to the user`s Title, unless a Magic Resistance is made (the type of slime is left to the GM`s discretion). While in this form, the user acquires that slime`s natural abilities and physical attributes yet retains their mental and mystical attributes, as well as their Charm. The user is restricted from using physical skills that the slime would be physically incapable of. This transformation fades after 2d4 hours.

Slumberheart.name: Slumberheart
Slumberheart.description: Puts a being or creature to sleep until they are fully healed. Corpses wrapped in vine within 1 hour of death per Will Force will come back to life as their lost Endurance is restored. Any ongoing damage is halted immediately upon falling asleep, but decapitations, acid damage, destroyed brain or heart, etc., will not heal. Beings regenerate while sleeping at a rate of 4 Endurance per hour to all wounded areas. Recovery from death permanently drains a Will Force and takes 30 days minus 1 day per Will Force of the being to recover. If the vine is removed from a sleeping being before they reaches total Endurance, they will awaken for 1d6 minutes and then die again. Recovery from insanity and control takes 20 days minus 1 day per Will Force. Disease, poison effects, scarring, etc. are all healed after 1 full day of sleep. All healing takes a minimum of 1 day of sleep regardless of the being`s Will Force. Affected beings sleep so deeply and so still that it takes Life Sense or Physiology (or a similar effect) to tell they are alive. When completely healed, a Will Force save is required for sleeping beings to awaken. They are afforded one of these each morning until they awaken.

Smogthorn.name: Smogthorn
Smogthorn.description: Emits a Type XV (1d6/minute PR success, 1d6/10 seconds PR fail). Potency Q (Instant) poisonous, repugnant brown fog in a 20` radius. This fog`s repugnant stench spreads over an area 200` from each root, and any being who smells it must make a half Vitality save or suffer a -4 penalty to hit and +4 Initiative. Because of Smogthorn`s stench and rancid taste, a Will Force save must be made to begin eating it, and a Vitality save must be made not to vomit. If successfully eaten, Smogthorn grants Breathless, Spell Turning, and Magical Flight in any direction at 3` per Intelligence point per second. The being does not need to maintain concentration while flying, but still must make Intelligence saves to successful change direction or make any difficult moves. Furthermore, an Agility save must be made while handling this plant to avoid 2d4 thrusting damage from thorns.

Speckled Dreamstar.name: Speckled Dreamstar
Speckled Dreamstar.description: Results in the user`s next dream portraying a magical view of someone, something, or someplace the user is thinking about as they fall asleep. The user is essentially scrying on the being, object, or place while they dream, and they can clearly hear all sound nearby as if they were actually there. Beings with Non-Detection, Sphere of Protection, Wall of Protection, Mind Set, Mind Change, or the skill Thought Projection cannot be scryed upon in this fashion, and those with Silence cannot be heard. Beings with Life Sense or Sense Projection are given an Intelligence save to feel that someone is magically spying on them through a dream.

Spiritseed(Seed).name: Spiritseed(Seed)
Spiritseed(Seed).description: Opens a portal to the Plane of Life, after being breathed on by a living being for 10 minutes, with a 10% chance of a Beta Life Elemental appearing. Once an elemental appears, it remains until banished/destroyed. The portal takes 10 minutes to form, destroying the Spiritseed.

Spiritseed(Tree).name: Spiritseed(Tree)
Spiritseed(Tree).description: Upon the tree`s outer surface lies a silvery sheen of Life energy, inflicting 6d4 damage to any undead or negative life force beings to the body area touching the tree, as well as 1d4 adjacent body areas if a Magic Resistance is made, and destruction if a Magic Resistance at -6% is failed. It also heals 6d4 to the body area touched, as well as 1d4 adjacent body areas, for any living or positive life force beings. If a corpse touches the tree within 6 minutes of death, it may make a half Will Force save to be resurrected. Even if this roll is failed, if the skills Resurrection, Recover, or True Recovery is begun on the deceased within 3 minutes, the being may make a new Will Force save with a bonus of +3% to be resurrected and permanently loses 1 Will Force.

Spying Lady.name: Spying Lady
Spying Lady.description: Allows someone to listen in on one person, place, or thing on the user`s current plane, as if their sense of hearing was within hearing of the person, place, or thing. The user must state their target`s name aloud. Beings with Non-Detection, Sphere of Protection, Wall of Protection, Mind Set, Mind Change, Silence, or Thought Projection cannot be detected, and beings with Life Sense or Sense Projection (or similar effects) are given an Intelligence save to feel they are being eavesdropped upon.

Star Violet.name: Star Violet
Star Violet.description: Grants immunity to the user`s mind against mental attacks, control, effects of insanity, or converting to a mental-only form of undead, such as a Horror. If the user is already insane or controlled, then these effects are temporarily removed. Furthermore, mental attributes are protected from being drained involuntarily. The user cannot themselves engage in mental combat or contact another being telepathically, nor can they be mentally contacted or probed by others while the herb is in effect.

Sunfruit.name: Sunfruit
Sunfruit.description: Restores personal attributes that were lost involuntarily.

Thornblaze.name: Thornblaze
Thornblaze.description: Grants +2d4 Will Force for the duration when touched, but also inflicts 2d6 magical fire damage unless a Magic Resistance is made. Its thorns inflict 1d4 thrusting damage, and anyone who takes 1 point of damage from thorns must make an Illusion Resistance or feel incredibly painful burning as the thorn`s power enters the bloodstream and flows throughout her body. If this resistance is failed, the user is incapacitated and must make a Vitality save every minute or fall unconscious for the duration.

Tombseed(Seed).name: Tombseed(Seed)
Tombseed(Seed).description: Opens a portal to the Plane of Death, after being placed on a corpse that died within the last 10 minutes, for 10 minutes, with a 10% chance of a Beta Death Elemental appearing. Once an elemental appears, it remains until banished/destroyed. The portal takes 10 minutes to form, destroying the Tombseed.

Tombseed(Tree).name: Tombseed(Tree)
Tombseed(Tree).description: Upon the tree`s outer surface lies a glistening black sheen of Death energy, inflicting 6d4 damage to any living being`s body area touching the tree, as well as 1d4 adjacent body areas if a Magic Resistance is made, and death if a Magic Resistance at -6% is failed. It also heals 6d4 to the body area touched, as well as 1d4 adjacent body areas, for undead or negative life force beings. If a living target dies from this effect, there is a 15% chance they will rise as an appropriate undead of the Game Master`s choice. The target may resist this with a Will Force save at -12%.

Trance Thistle.name: Trance Thistle
Trance Thistle.description: Transfixes any who catch sight of the plant for 10 minutes, unless a Control Resistance is made. Anyone so affected must stare at the plant for the duration, having no other actions. They do, however, get a new Control Resistance each 10 seconds. If line of sight contact is broken, the affected beings are freed from this entrancement, but the released creature must make another Control Resistance if they look at the plant again or be entranced. Upon ingesting any part of the plant, the user falls into a meditative trance for 10 minutes, during which they will experience 2d4 premonitions of themselves and/or others. During this state and afterward, the following benefits apply: A new Control Resistance towards any current controlling factors and a +10% Control Resistance. +1 to hit and damage for 1 hour after the herb`s duration. Current fatigue effects are reduced by half. Fatigue effects for the duration happen twice as slowly (1 minute of fatigue is applied per 2 actual minutes). One temporarily lost attribute point is restored per 30 minutes while awake, and one per 10 minutes while asleep. The user counts as having 1 Will Force rating higher when defending against a hostile spell or effect which depends on Will Force, such as mental combat, the spell and invocation Hold, Possession, etc.

Troll`s Hair.name: Troll`s Hair
Troll`s Hair.description: Causes -1d4 Vitality and Agility, causes 3 levels of fatigue, and prevents the user from being healed in any way, unless a Poison Resistance is made.

Twisted Roperoot.name: Twisted Roperoot
Twisted Roperoot.description: Protects an undead, death elemental, etc., from the damage caused by life/positive based powers, skills, spells, and effects. Thus, the effects that cause damage, blinding, burns, etc. from positive or life-based attacks have no effect on the protected undead. This does not stop turning, banishment, or destruction based positive/life effects. Furthermore, this vine grants immunity to all beings from the effects of pressure in water and in lava, as well as the benefits of Endure Heat, Endure Cold, and Breathless.

Vaporleaf.name: Vaporleaf
Vaporleaf.description: Creates a magical wind to blow in the direction the incense stick is pointing. This wind has a constant speed of 50 miles per hour for as long as the incense is burning.

Vitalia.name: Vitalia
Vitalia.description: Grants immunity to the effects of pressure in water and lava, as well as the benefits of Endure Death, Endure Heat, Endure Cold, and Breathless.

Wargweed.name: Wargweed
Wargweed.description: Places the user in a death-like state. Respiration and circulation are halted, and no muscle movement can occur. The user loses the senses of smell, touch, and taste, but can still hear and see. Wounds do not bleed, and the user is immune to poison and disease while in this deathlike state.

Wanderstalk.name: Wanderstalk
Wanderstalk.description: -1d4 Knowledge when first touched, unless a Magic Resistance is made. While the user is holding or wearing a piece at least 6 inches long, they and everything they are carrying will be teleported every 1d4x10 minutes to a random location within 100`. A Magic Resistance is allowed for each teleportation. Every 2d4 minutes, this plant molds itself into various bushes, saplings, vines, mushrooms, and flowers no larger than 4 cubic feet. Each piece held or worn by a being continues to mold shape every 2d4 minutes, assuming the form of any similar-sized object of which the user has knowledge. When the user drops or puts down the piece of Wanderstalk, it will affect the next being who touches it within the next 2d4 minutes. If nobody has touched it by then, it shifts into its natural form, a dead weed, and its magic fades.

Waverider.name: Waverider
Waverider.description: Reduces Poison Resistance by 25% for 1d4+1 hours. Can be mixed with any poison to lower the resistance against it.

Wellspring.name: Wellspring
Wellspring.description: Draws water from the surrounding terrain in the following manner: Wet earth (4 gallons), Earth (1 gallon), Wet Rock (2 quarts), Plant (2 quarts), Rock (2 pints), Dry (2 cups).

Weeping Mindseed.name: Weeping Mindseed
Weeping Mindseed.description: Allows the user to make mental contact with a targeted being within 100` of another Weeping Mindseed tree. If the targeted being goes beyond range, the mental contact is broken.

Witherwhiff.name: Witherwhiff
Witherwhiff.description: Contains a static shield around it, stunning anyone who touches it for 3d4+3 seconds, unless a Magic Resistance is made. This static shield endures indefinitely while planted and for 1 week after being picked. A being must only make a new Magic Resistance if it leaves their Aura field and they attempt to touch it again. Anyone wearing or holding a Witherwhiff blossom will gain this static shield. Furthermore, the blossom also has a 2` radius air pocket around it full of breathable oxygen, but anyone inside the air pocket has a -2d4 Appearance, and all objects appear old and covered in rust or dirt.

Wild Scarlytte.name: Wild Scarlytte
Wild Scarlytte.description: Acts as a hallucinogen, unless a Magic Resistance is made, causing the user to experience a wide variety of scents, textures, tastes, and sounds, as well as a temporary -2d4 Intelligence and Wisdom. Each successive dose of Wild Scarlytte results in a cumulative -10% chance (for that attribute save) that 1 lost attribute point per dose will be permanently gone.

Witch`s Cap.name: Witch`s Cap
Witch`s Cap.description: Allows one user who ingests half the mushroom to shroud their mind in a near complete mental copy of another user who holds the mushroom`s other half. Whenever anyone mentally contacts the being who ingested, they sense the duplicated mind and not the actual mind. If the one who ingested engages or is engaged in mental combat or a strong mental connection with another being, then the herb`s effect immediately fails. The being who ingested is allowed a double Perception Check to receive thoughts, emotions, and details from the being holding the other half of the mushroom that they were thinking and feeling at the time of mental duplication.

Withersprite.name: Withersprite
Withersprite.description: Inflicts 3d6+3 death damage to the body area touched (unless a Magic Resistance is made), but also instills the ability to locate and speak to any spirit of a being who died by drowning, as long as the user knows that being`s True Name, as per the skill Speak to Dead. Wounding damage is only applied once, but the power of speaking to a drowned spirit continues for as long as the user is touching the Withersprite.

Wormroot.name: Wormroot
Wormroot.description: +1d4 Strength and Vitality for the duration, and envelops the user in 2 magical layers of physical armor with a combined armor rating of 30. The inner layer is considered flexible and the outer layer is semi-flexible. This magical armor will appear below any clothing or armor already worn, and weighs 30 pounds.

Wraith Heart.name: Wraith Heart
Wraith Heart.description: Creates a 20` wide sphere of suffocating darkness which negates all forms of vision. All beings within the sphere begin to choke, losing 1d6 overall Endurance per 10 seconds. At the onset of asphyxiation, a Will Force save must be made to remain calm or damage is doubled. When Endurance has been reduced to 0, a being appears very pale and must make a Vitality save every 5 seconds to remain conscious (-5% to the save for every point below 0). Once Endurance reaches a being`s negative Vitality rating, the lungs have collapsed and the heart stops beating. One minute later, if Endurance is not raised above the negative Vitality rating, the being dies. A Chirugeon roll will resuscitate the suffocated being and raise overall Endurance to 1 point above negative Vitality. Should a being survive the ordeal, restoration of Endurance is based on the healing rate of the character, with minutes instead of days and a period of 10-minute intervals instead of weeks. If the being dies from suffocation, the user has a 100% chance minus the user's Will Force rating of returning as a physical undead within 10 minutes of death.

Angel`s Bane.name: Angel`s Bane
Angel`s Bane.description: All Angels under 10th level, and Celestial Incarnates under 10th Title must make a Control Resistance to attack or even approach within 20 feet of the protected being.

Angel`s Sight Bark.name: Angel`s Sight Bark
Angel`s Sight Bark.description: Grants Life Sensing at 3` per Will Force rating.

Archon`s Truth.name: Archon`s Truth
Archon`s Truth.description: When this golden grape (or it`s liquid contents) are consumed the being makes a Control Resistance at -20%, If they fail, they must speak the truth for the duration.

Clearleaf.name: Clearleaf
Clearleaf.description: Restores mental and physical well-being. All negative mental and physical effects removed (as the effect Restore). However, it does not remove possession or control.

Dead Man`s Ghost.name: Dead Man`s Ghost
Dead Man`s Ghost.description: Separates the imbiber`s spirit from their body for the duration of the effect. During this time, they may travel as if under the effects of Spirit Travel, and their body, for all intents and purposes, seems completely dead, with no pulse or breath or any other signs the subject is still alive. For every 2 hours of duration, the body temporarily loses one point of Vitality. This loss can kill those whose bodies are frail. After reawakening, the points return at the rate of 1 point per hour. If two or more seeds are ground together, or more than 1 is consumed in a 12 hour period, treat it as a Type XX (Duration 1d6 minutes. 1d4/minute PR success, Death PR fail) poison with Potency I (1d10 minutes).

Demon`s Breath.name: Demon`s Breath
Demon`s Breath.description: When this blackened tomato-like vegetable (or it`s liquid contents) are consumed the being makes a -20% Control Resistance Or they will believe the first person who speaks to them for the duration.

Devil`s Bane.name: Devil`s Bane
Devil`s Bane.description: All Devils under 10th level, and Infernal Incarnates under 10th Title must make a Control Resistance to attack or even approach within 20 feet of the protected being.

Devil`s Root.name: Devil`s Root
Devil`s Root.description: It is a Type XX (Duration 1d6 minutes. 1d4/minute PR success, Death PR fail), Potency Q (Instant) poison. Whether they make a Poison Resistance or not they are transported to the beginning of the long march to the gates of the city of the damned on the first level of Hell. If they die from the poison then they arrive dead, otherwise alive, though they may not stay so for long.

Devil`s Walk.name: Devil`s Walk
Devil`s Walk.description: When consumed it allows a person to mental think of an appearance and transform into that being as the spell Change True for the duration. They are limited to beings within 1` of their normal size or weight. The following attributes (Strength, Agility, Vitality, and Appearance) can be increased or decreased by up to 4 points as long as these stay within racial maximum and the minimum of 5.

Ever Bulb.name: Ever Bulb
Ever Bulb.description: grants +20% to all Mental Saving Throws and +20% resistance to effects which control.

First Tree Leaf.name: First Tree Leaf
First Tree Leaf.description: Opens a portal, surrounded by a gray fog to the tree in the center of the Plane of Balance.

Heaven`s Gate.name: Heaven`s Gate
Heaven`s Gate.description: Opens a portal, surrounded by a golden mist to the Gates of Heaven. The side of the gate the portal appears to matches the whether the moss is burned in or out of the Heavens. Burning the moss outside opens the portal to outside, and vice versa.

Hive Fruit.name: Hive Fruit
Hive Fruit.description: Each person that consumes the seed becomes 1 part of a Mass Mind as the skill of the same name.

Wildtail Fern.name: Wildtail Fern
Wildtail Fern.description: When consumed it allows a being to be able to magically speak (as the spell Animal Speak) with animals of one imagined type. They also have telepathy with the that type of animal within 1 mile per Will Force of the being.

Aria`s Tee Leaf.name: Aria`s Tee Leaf
Aria`s Tee Leaf.description: Arastia Herb: The drinker is unable to mentally contacted, sensed or be engaged in mental combat. They also cannot use any mind reading or telepathic skills, abilities or powers of their own. Also, their dreams cannot be read nor can they be dream summoned.

Golden Gift Berry.name: Golden Gift Berry
Golden Gift Berry.description: Arastia Herb: Each berry is a XV antitoxin removing current poison effects and will also grant a new Disease Resistance against a current disease at a +20%. The being or creature that consumed it gains +20% to Poison Resistance and Disease Resistance.

Light`s Latch.name: Light`s Latch
Light`s Latch.description: Arastia Herb: The body part placed on can pass through the planar boundary to the demi-plane of phase to Phase Adhere objects or surfaces on the phase plane. Lasts for the duration or until wiped off.

Monk`s Repose Spores.name: Monk`s Repose Spores
Monk`s Repose Spores.description: Arastia Herb: Spread on the face of the individual. The spores are mildly toxic and thus a Poison Resistance is required. If it is failed then the head (face) takes 1d4+1 damage from a mild withering effect that will heal when the spores are no longer active. While the spores are on the face the Life Force of the individual wearing the spores is completely masked. They cannot be life sensed, etc.

Paranoia Root.name: Paranoia Root
Paranoia Root.description: Arastia Herb: Cause the person to have a strange sense of paranoia. The being feels they are being watched and mistrusts anyone they do not deeply love or trust. Wisdom save to see through this paranoia when requested.

Priest`s Cowl.name: Priest`s Cowl
Priest`s Cowl.description: Arastia Herb: Laid over the striking part of any weapon. The preparer rubs their hands together quickly until they are warm and then places them over the flower which is on the weapon. There is a strong tingling sensation as the heat (and being`s Aura) activates the flower. It suffuses onto the weapon. The weapon is now considered +1 magical (+1 to hit and damage) for the duration.

Seer`s Eye Beans.name: Seer`s Eye Beans
Seer`s Eye Beans.description: Arastia Herb: Grants Life Sensing within 3` per Will Force rating of the individual affected for 1d4+1 hours.

Shadow`s Grip.name: Shadow`s Grip
Shadow`s Grip.description: Arastia Herb: The body part placed on can pass through the planar boundary to the demi-plane of shadow to Shadow Adhere objects or surfaces on the Plane of Shadow. Lasts for the duration or until wiped off.

Shadow Sward.name: Shadow Sward
Shadow Sward.description: Arastia Herb: Makes a temporary brittle-bladed, magical, shadow weapon. The blade is considered +1 and is shadow weapon extending across the planar boundary into the shadow plane as well as the natural universe. It is also magically sharp (sharpness at 5 Aura.) The blade is brittle though and every strike on any hard object (rigid armor, another weapon or shield, wood, metal, stone, etc.) does 1d4+1 damage to it. It starts off with the strength of whatever blade it has been coaxed into being.

Thessa`s Tubers.name: Thessa`s Tubers
Thessa`s Tubers.description: Arastia Herb: Magically hydrates and nourishes the being or animal that consumed it for one entire day.

Xavier`s Moss.name: Xavier`s Moss
Xavier`s Moss.description: Arastia Herb: To use sprinkle the powder over a person or object. As long as they do not move, they are magically hidden (as the spell Hide).

Zera`s Nectar.name: Zera`s Nectar
Zera`s Nectar.description: Arastia Herb: Heals 3d4+3 to all wounded areas (including base Endurance). The nectar is toxic if not boiled and strained first, poison Type X (Duration 1d6 minutes. No damage PR success, 1d8/minute PR fail), Potency L (1d4 minutes)
